plain: Having to do with the sea, shipping or trade by sea

webster.text: Relating or pertaining to the sea or ocean; as maritime affairs.

more.text: Bordering on the sea; as a maritime coast.
Situated near the sea; as maritime towns.
Having a navy and commerce by sea; as maritime powers.

example.quote: The most bigoted idolizers of State authority have not thus far shown a disposition to deny the national judiciary the cognizances of maritime causes.
